#Weather Patterns 

Below is a graphical summary of the weather data in the NY locations .

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(measurements)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)

data("ny_noaa")

ny_noaa = ny_noaa %>%
  mutate(
  year = year(date),
  month = month(date),
  day = day(date),
      tmax = as.numeric(tmax),
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin),
    prcp = prcp / 254,
    snow = snow / 25.4,
    snwd = snwd / 25.4,
    tmax = conv_unit(tmax / 10, "C", "F"),
    tmin = conv_unit(tmin / 10, "C", "F")
  )

#Merging data set with station locations, using NOAA documentation 

url <- "https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/daily/ghcnd-stations.txt"

stations <- read_fwf(
  url,
  fwf_cols(id = c(1, 11), name = c(42, 71))
)

#Flitering to only Rochester and NYC stations
ny_new <- ny_noaa %>%
  left_join(stations, by = "id") %>%
  filter(name %in% c("ROCHESTER GTR INTL", "NY CITY CNTRL PARK" ),
         year(date) >= 2000)

```

#Total Yearly snow in Rochester and NYC Cenral park

```{r}
ny_new %>%
  group_by(name, year) %>%
  summarise(total_snow = sum(snow, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  plot_ly(x= ~year, y = ~total_snow, color = ~name, 
          type =   "bar")
  
```

#Average Yearly precipitation by year in Rochester and NYC Central Park
```{r}
ny_new %>%
  group_by(name, year) %>%
  summarise(avg_prcp = mean(prcp, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  plot_ly(x= ~year, y = ~avg_prcp, color = ~name, type= "scatter", mode = "lines+markers") 
```


#Monthly minimum temp yearly in Rochester
```{r}
ny_new %>%
  filter(name == "ROCHESTER GTR INTL") %>%
  group_by(name,month,year) %>%
  summarise(monthly_min = min(tmin, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  plot_ly(x= ~month, y = ~monthly_min, color = ~year, type= "scatter", mode = "lines+markers") 
```

#Monthly minimum temp yearly in NYC Central Park
```{r}
ny_new %>%
  filter(name == "NY CITY CNTRL PARK") %>%
  group_by(name,month,year) %>%
  summarise(monthly_min = min(tmin, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  plot_ly(x= ~month, y = ~monthly_min, color = ~year, type= "scatter", mode = "lines+markers") 
```
